questions.question: How should the public commit be structured?

options.label: Single snapshot commit (Recommended)
options.description: One commit on public main summarizing the new private work (perm_gate_lab, manager-eval, etc.). Matches the existing public history model — public stays a sanitized portfolio snapshot, not a full mirror.

options.label: Several thematic commits
options.description: Split into roughly one commit per private feature (perm_gate_lab, manager-eval, ...). More history, but each diff still loses its real authorship/file granularity since we're sanitizing a snapshot.

questions.question: When should we do the "switch to public as primary" cutover?

options.label: Not now — just sync today (Recommended)
options.description: I'll do the sync only. We discuss the cutover plan separately (it's bigger: changes the dev origin, retires the private repo as primary, decides what stays private).

options.label: Plan it in this session
options.description: After the sync, I'll lay out a switch plan (re-pointing remotes, what to do with private-only files like DECISIONS GD-0007, secrets posture, worktree origins) but won't execute it yet.

options.label: Execute the switch in this session
options.description: After sync, repoint origins so future work happens on the public repo. This affects all worktrees and the supervisor — requires more care; I'd ask again before any destructive step.

transcript_tail.text: We have created a public version of this repo and make... made this, uh, private one. I want to sync again all the new work from the private to the public one and later make a switch to adopt the public as the one we're gonna work from now on.
I'll investigate the current state before acting — the publish flow and what's changed since the last sync.
Got the picture. Let me check the public repo state more carefully and what new work needs syncing.

Here's what I'm seeing:

**Private** (`~/dev/ai-harness`, on `main`): 6 new commits since the last publish snapshot 1af0a8e — `perm_gate_lab phase 1`, `manager-eval phases 1+2`, plus prep commits.

**Public** (`~/dev/ai-harness-public`, on `main`): 1 commit (3e31445, the initial snapshot). Clean.

The publish model is **squashed-snapshot**, not real-history mirroring — each public commit is a fresh `sanitize_export.sh` build of private HEAD. To sync, the recipe is:

1. Run `sanitize_export.sh` against private `main` into a temp dir
2. `rsync` that tree into `~/dev/ai-harness-public/` (delete extras, preserve `.git`)
3. Review diff, commit on public as a new snapshot commit, push

I want to confirm a couple of things before touching the public repo.
